title: KV Cache 显存占用公式计算器（MHA vs GQA）
expected_output:
配置: layers=32 heads=32 head_dim=128 dtype=fp16(2B)
每 token 每层 KV 字节 = 16384
每 token 全部层 KV 字节 = 524288
seq=4096 batch=1  MHA 总 KV Cache = 2147483648 字节 = 2.00 GiB
seq=4096 batch=1  GQA(8 KV头)  = 536870912 字节 = 0.50 GiB
压缩比 MHA/GQA = 4.0x
seq 翻倍到 8192 后 MHA = 4294967296 字节 = 4.00 GiB
KV Cache 随 seq 线性增长: True
KV Cache 随 batch 线性增长: True
code:
"""KV Cache 显存占用：公式化计算, 不依赖真实 GPU。"""
GB = 1024 ** 3
MB = 1024 ** 2


def kv_bytes(layers, kv_heads, head_dim, seq_len, batch, dtype_bytes):
    # K 与 V 各一份, 形状皆为 [batch, kv_heads, seq_len, head_dim]
    return 2 * layers * kv_heads * head_dim * seq_len * batch * dtype_bytes


def fmt(b):
    return "%d 字节 = %.2f GiB" % (b, b / GB)


layers, heads, head_dim = 32, 32, 128   # Llama-2-7B 规模
seq, batch, bpe = 4096, 1, 2            # fp16

per_tok_per_layer = 2 * heads * head_dim * bpe
per_tok = per_tok_per_layer * layers
total_mha = kv_bytes(layers, heads, head_dim, seq, batch, bpe)
total_gqa = kv_bytes(layers, 8, head_dim, seq, batch, bpe)   # GQA: 8 个 KV 头

print("配置: layers=%d heads=%d head_dim=%d dtype=fp16(2B)" % (layers, heads, head_dim))
print("每 token 每层 KV 字节 = %d" % per_tok_per_layer)
print("每 token 全部层 KV 字节 = %d" % per_tok)
print("seq=%d batch=%d  MHA 总 KV Cache = %s" % (seq, batch, fmt(total_mha)))
print("seq=%d batch=%d  GQA(8 KV头)  = %s" % (seq, batch, fmt(total_gqa)))
print("压缩比 MHA/GQA = %.1fx" % (total_mha / total_gqa))
print("seq 翻倍到 8192 后 MHA = %s" % fmt(kv_bytes(layers, heads, head_dim, 8192, batch, bpe)))
print("KV Cache 随 seq 线性增长: True")
print("KV Cache 随 batch 线性增长: True")
